activity_context.topic_title: Finding the First Term of an Arithmetic Series

feedback.problem: What is the first term of an arithmetic series if the common difference is $d=5,$ and the sum of the first $11$ terms is ${S}_{11}=374?$
feedback.worked_solution:
We are given the common difference of the series. So, to find the first term, we use the formula for the sum of an arithmetic series in the form

$$
{S}_{N}=\frac{N}{2}(2{a}_{1}+(N-1)d),
$$

where ${a}_{1}$ is the first term, $d$ is the common difference, and $N$ is the number of terms.

Substituting $N=11$, $d=5$, and ${S}_{N}=374$ into the formula above, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}374 & =\frac{11}{2}(2{a}_{1}+(11-1)(5)) \\ 748 & =11(2{a}_{1}+50) \\ 68 & =2{a}_{1}+50 \\ 18 & =2{a}_{1} \\ {a}_{1} & =9.\end{aligned}
$$
